accepted.rationale: MOSS consistently attributes the early response, the dominant portion of the 6–13 second interval, and the final task-related remark to S01. Their chronology and shared stopwatch/task context support one continuing speaker despite noisy transcripts and a brief ambiguous S02 overlap in the middle observation; the below-threshold TST scores are weak contrary evidence from very short snippets rather than positive evidence for another known person.

This interval primarily captures the distinct S02 turn around 12 seconds, while TST also rejects matches to the preceding raw voices. A shorter S01 overlap near the interval boundary makes the assignment moderately rather than highly confident, but the most likely default is a second unnamed participant represented by the existing person_2 character.
